test_title: PYST 18: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 04 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No dolls are rings.

No rings are lamps.

**Conclusions:**

(I) All dolls are lamps.

(II) No lamps are dolls.
solution:
Statements:

No dolls are rings.

No rings are lamps.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b3e7fbcc6d7dcd8502fbb350c972d695c0e3db5c96873ea944fd61dbe90db23.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) All dolls are lamps. - False (There is no definite relation between dolls and lamps, it can be possible but it is not definite)

(II) No lamps are dolls. - False (There is no definite relation between lamps and dolls, it can be possible but it is not definite)

Thus, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
